question: In the experimental matrix of sewage sludge co-incineration in a fluidized bed, which runs vary the bed particle size, and to what sizes?
expect: runs 6 and 7: 545 um and 775 um (all other runs 650 um) (Table 2)
rendered:
Standardisation of natural dye powders via spray drying: initial physicochemical characterisation is not relevant to this question.

Carbon-Free Ammonia Co-firing in Fluidized Bed Combustion: Analysis of Advanced Chemical Modeling and Detailed Mechanism is not relevant to this question.

The relevant document is Co-Incineration of Real Municipal Sewage Sludge in a Fluidized Bed: Effects of the Coexistence of P, Fe, and Na on Agglomeration and Heavy Metal Emissions.

According to the experimental matrix in Table 2, runs 5, 6, 10, and 11 vary the bed particle size.
